scope: targeted source inspection, not an exhaustive branch or experiment revalidation

findings.finding: A local disk inventory cannot observe a remote private vault. The correction reports 22 listed files and three byte-identical round trips, not a fresh verification by this audit.
findings.disposition: Require exact remote repository, immutable ref, paths, access state and method capability. Three checked objects do not establish 22-object integrity.

findings.finding: There is no 35, no deep-any anywhere, and nobody trained on the selection bank are broader than a scoped literal search or two declared file inventories alone can establish. This is not evidence that the corrected scores or parser inspection are wrong.
findings.disposition: Keep parser inspection and measured overlaps scoped. Global code absence needs a complete declared source universe; execution claims need run-bound provenance, not merely declarations.

findings.finding: Empty banks, absent context fields and empty strings can return clean=True because missing text is coerced to an empty string.
findings.disposition: Require nonempty rendered text and unique row IDs before treating a mechanical scan as informative.

findings.finding: The hit-rate loop skips absent/ambiguous reference sentences while the candidate-floor loop uses a broader population. Missing candidates fall back to a non-candidate floor.
findings.disposition: Bind one common scorable population; expose skipped IDs; refuse whole-bank claims on partial coverage and candidate-floor claims without a declared candidate universe.

findings.finding: Inapplicable sweeps become [] or 0.0 in helper returns. A nonempty two-level input with an empty pool can still yield applicable=True and zero rule scores.
findings.disposition: Separate unobservable from observed-zero and observed sensitivity. Check actual rows/pool, prior input digest, level counts and prospectively declared rule coverage.

findings.finding: The secondary still uses earliest_person and emits a residual-position-cue interpretation; the record subsequently withdraws the candidate-identity cue rationale. A single directional-cue caveat is not an exhaustive directional sweep.
findings.disposition: Treat this legacy secondary as descriptive only until a source-bound, nonzero-swing rule qualification exists. Do not rescore or modify primary results.

findings.finding: Dictionary construction can overwrite duplicate IDs or pair-band rows. A missing prediction field becomes an empty string while the ID still counts as present.
findings.disposition: Reject duplicates and missing prediction fields; preserve genuinely emitted empty strings; require both bands in the same cell and complete registered cell coverage.

findings.finding: File bytes, tensor identity, numerical meaning and determinism are different properties. The illustrative tensor loop inspects keys in A, so extra keys only in B are outside its view.
findings.disposition: Retain existing hash corrections. Inventory alone cannot establish byte integrity; file mismatch alone cannot establish tensor or behavioural change; tensor comparison requires both key sets, shape, dtype and payload scope.
